caption: The drawing depicts a tall, wooden grandfather clock positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The clock is rendered in brown tones, with detailed wood grain visible throughout its structure. The main body consists of three sections: a rectangular base with a scalloped edge at the bottom, a central column with a recessed rectangular panel, and an upper clock housing with a curved, decorative pediment. The clock face is circular and pale in color, showing black Arabic numerals and two black clock hands. Surrounding the clock face is an arched frame, with blue and yellow decorative elements above the face. The name "PAUL CHILDERS" appears in small black letters in the bottom right corner of the drawing. There are no other objects or additional elements in the image.
title: Shaker Tall Clock
